lyrics:
[Intro: sequenced bass, guitar chug, sampled crowd]

[Verse 1: gruff male voice, deadpan]
New and improved, the same as before
Nine out of ten can't take any more
Award-winning, market-leading
Now with thirty percent more bleeding edge

[Chorus: full band, female voices shouting]
Brand awareness! (Know our name)
Brand awareness! (Say it again)
You have been reached, you have been served
Brand awareness!

[Verse 2: gruff, synth stabs]
Limited time, unlimited noise
Trusted by girls and trusted by boys
Scalable, shareable, loud by design
Terms and conditions in very small type

[Chorus: full band, female voices shouting]
Brand awareness! (Know our name)
Brand awareness! (Say it again)
You have been reached, you have been served
Brand awareness!

[Bridge: beat only, female voice, sweet]
This message was brought to you
By the people who brought you this message

[Guitar Break: wah solo over the sequencer]

[Final Chorus: loudest, gang vocals]
Brand awareness! (Know our name)
Brand awareness! (Say it again)
You have been reached, you have been served
Brand awareness!

[Outro: sequencer, a jingle chord, "Thank you."]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 135 BPM, 4/4, E minor. A pounding, bouncing industrial dance-rock beat with a grin.

VOICE: Male lead, gruff and accented, delivering slogans deadpan. Two or three women shout the responses in the choruses, and one speaks the bridge in a sweet advert voice. Gang vocals at the end.

INSTRUMENTS: A sequenced sixteenth-note synth bass, chugging metal rhythm guitar, a four-on-the-floor kick with a huge snare, brass-like synth stabs, a wah-pedal guitar solo, sampled crowd noise, a cheerful jingle chord at the end.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, sequencer and guitar. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:38 Chorus 1. 1:00 Verse 2. 1:24 Chorus 2. 1:46 Bridge, the advert voice. 2:00 Guitar break. 2:20 Final chorus. 2:50 Outro, jingle and 'Thank you' at 3:14.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 1997 industrial rock: loud, tight and punchy, guitars and sequencer locked, vocals dry.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The bridge's circular advert line at 1:46.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original band mocks its own legend. Now everybody is asked to be a brand, so the joke has a much larger target.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Confident, louder, absurd, pleased with itself.
